comments.content: [medium] The urlencoding crate isn't imported here. The dependency is already declared in Cargo.toml, so just add `use urlencoding;` or `use urlencoding::decode;` to the imports at the top of the file.

[low] Consider adding a focused test that constructs a LocalDist and asserts the exposed canonical version matches what the underlying distribution carries, guarding against the two representations drifting apart over time.

[low] It may be worth adding a regression test with percent-encoded characters other than separators, such as encoded spaces or non-ASCII bytes, to confirm the decoding behavior here is intentional and stable across future changes.
